Context: 1-B. 'Workplace' includes:-

- (ii) An online complaint management system titled "Sexual Harassment electronic-Box (Sl-le-Box)" has been launched. Complaints filed in SHe-Box will be sent directly to the Internal Complaint Committee of the Ministry/ Department/ PSU / AB concerned, which has the jurisdiction to inquire into the complaint. Progress of inquiry can also be monitored.  
- GID (25-K), Rule 3-C.
